items.note: S2.1.1 states the eight-row gadget adding x_S to y_S for arbitrary scratch and S2.1.2 gives the three-stage computation (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) as at 761-763. Why the gadget works is not shown: the net change (JV+RG)x and the cancellation of central coefficients by side injection (742-759) are missing.

S2.2 gives frames, edge changes D_vD_u^{-1}, the commuting reason and D_sink D_source^{-1}. It leaves out the route sign epsilon_w and the routing to rho(w) (818-822), and the sign matters in the complex exchange.

S2.3 gives nested nondegenerate labels from tensored triple lines with comparable endpoints. It omits the neighbour orthogonality, the only decreasing edges (center 3->4, loss h), L=Ich, the sum Wm-2N+2L and L<N/2. It also names the total dimension change 's', but for the bit network s_b differs from that sum by N.

S2.4 gives the XOR network realising rho, endpoint differences I_m, the shear H<-H+D and s_b<W_b m, matching 1138-1153. The projection matrices, the -P_{U_a} source matrices and the formula W_b m-N+2L_b are not given.

S2.5 correctly has one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector and s_c<W_c m. It says telescoping gives C^{tensor m} on every role, but the paper needs the source and sink diagonal corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange (1225-1227, 1297-1314). The phase frames C_U and the formula for s_c are absent.

s<Wm is asserted for both networks, and S3.5.1 gives tau=1-2^{-50} with s_b/W_b<m^tau. Missing are L<N/2, the deficit values eta_b and eta_c, the argument through log m<20 and eta>20*2^{-50}, and sigma for the complex network.

S1.2 matches Lemma lem:elementary-streams. S1.3 states controlled shifts and rational unit scalings in O(V) unconditionally, dropping the conditions that the offset be prepared in b^{O(1)} time and that the denominators and numerators be prime to q (557-568). No proofs are given.

The factorization and the a-interchange cost are stated correctly, with elimination by pivoting and triangular controlled shifts as method. The step that makes each one of Pi cost a single interchange (D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j; 1432-1443) is missing, as is the choice of the prime q avoiding the denominators.

The plan follows the paper's route. Rows are split cyclically into W role streams of volume V/W, the bit network with Phi_{A_e} on edges gives H<-H+D, the three-shear interchange follows, then F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and the depth-first parking schedule at O(V) per node. This matches 1491-1615.

The O(Vu^tau) bound and the base-m split with row padding are given. The key device is missing: the row field is built from the top rho=O(log e) digits of the chunks themselves (1653-1681). The padding of binary ranges [2^u] to [q^e] is also absent.

S4.2 gives exactly s_c child calls on f=e/m chunks plus a fixed number of binary row additions, and S4.3 gives H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, both correct. The conjugation by P_M that moves the residual directions to coordinate slots, and the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, are not stated.

S4.4 matches the lemma: XORs at j_i=rho+iK, a restored third chunk, eight whole-chunk cyclic shifts, deterministic repair of a bad set of density at most 80(f-1)2^{-K}, and cost O(V(L^tau+1)) in the family. The eight-operation parity construction and the guard intervals are not shown.

The recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) and the row split are stated correctly. The unrolling cites a<m^lambda, whereas the paper uses a<=m^sigma with leaves cut off at e<d^beta, giving the condition lambda'>max{lambda,sigma+beta(1-sigma)} (2394-2448). The rows taken from the first q_0 chunks and the bound K<=e^{c/beta} are absent.

S4 follows the paper's proof: a C-layer by phase-frame recursion with packed XOR basis changes and row splitting, the recurrence, Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) guard bits with Delta=o(p), conversion to H_0, and one truncation with error below sqrt2*2^{-p}. The unrolling inside S4.6 is loose (see layer-recurrence).

The plan gives contractions, character cancellation, the decimation-in-frequency recursion, stored bit-reversed order B_tF_t^- and F_t^+B_t^{-1}, and the layout L with the correct cost and error. Missing are the grouping of the axis steps of a round into one parallel butterfly followed by the recordwise monomial J_E (2896-2915) and the derivation of the layout cost.

T2.4 has evaluation at 2^{4p}, the established O(N log N) multiplier, centered coefficient extraction and O(rp log(rp)) time, consistent with the lemma. It does not show the four products or the bound |h_j|<B_0/2.

T2 and T2.5 give the route correctly: two forward transforms kept in LB order, pointwise products divided by r, the opposite transform, scaling by M, and error below sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}. The normalization identity F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) and the error accounting through 3delta+eta (3422-3470) are not shown.

This follows the paper: TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS and ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}, Neumann inversion with A=S' and B_0=D'J'C, numerical maps with error p^2 in O(tp^{3/2+delta}alpha), and the linewise tensor form with error dp^2 and axis cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).
Both identities, eq:permuted-chirp and eq:source-permutation-cancel, are stated exactly. Their proofs (3938-3988) and the conjugation that gives RF_s^+ are not in the plan.

Sizes b, p, d, K, T, r and t_i, the primes with eta=1/(4d), T/2<S<T, theta_i>eta and the n^{o(1)} search are correct. The fixed exponents (epsilon, c, lambda, lambda', delta, beta) and alpha, gamma are missing, as is the condition alpha^4 theta_i>p.
The algebra isomorphism, triangular controlled shifts, axis reorders and cost are right. mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i is not defined, and the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_jP_j is not given.

The map x_d->zeta y with coefficient k multiplied by zeta^k is stated correctly as an isomorphism C[x_d]/(x_d^r-1)->C[y]/(y^r+1) giving the complex convolution after untwisting. The wrap check and the twist errors are omitted.

The source transform (A, chirp by ring convolution, B_0, 2^gamma) and the pipeline (digits, Phi, two source transforms, pointwise product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, carries) match. The input scaling 2^{-b-2} and the inverse map Phi^{-1} before carries are left out.

E_s=9*2^gamma TL (in units 2^{-p}) and the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 match eq:source-error and eq:final-error. The chain through E_ring, the chirp error, E_w and the use of gamma<=b/4 is not shown.

T4.9 states seven normalized terms, each at most p^{1-2kappa}, with smallest margin 2^{-181}=2kappa, and the final bound. The seven terms are not identified, and the absorption of fixed powers of log p into p^kappa, which turns 1-2kappa into 1-kappa, is missing.
R only tags the nlogn-conjecture as a dependency. No step states the eventual lower bound or that a liminf of zero refutes it. Counted as mentioned, conservatively.

errors.says: The total dimension change s over all edges is strictly less than Wm (S2 also calls the label dimension total s).
errors.paper: The sum of absolute label dimension changes is Wm-2N+2L (eq:rank-budget-labels). The bit network's rank sum is s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, which adds N for the negative source projections. Only in the complex case does s equal the label sum.

errors.says: The net operator on each routed role is D_sink D_source^{-1}.
errors.paper: The route from w to rho(w) applies epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, including the scalar sign epsilon_w.

errors.says: Telescoping gives C^{tensor m} on every role.
errors.paper: Telescoping gives C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates of u_a on X_a->Y_a. C^{tensor m} on every role holds only after the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} source and sink corrections, negation of the X outputs and undoing of the exchange.

errors.says: Updating a target field by an offset from earlier fields, or multiplying by a rational unit, takes O(V) time, stated without conditions.
errors.paper: O(V) holds when the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time from a fixed number of controls, q is prime, and the coefficients have denominators (and, for units, numerators) prime to q.

errors.says: For arbitrary chunk widths and arbitrary row counts, padding the row count to a multiple of W^k and splitting the width in base m gives the interchange.
errors.paper: The lemma has no row field. The proof creates one from the top rho=ceil(k log W/(2 log q)) digits of the two chunks, exchanges and joins them, then pads, and also pads the binary ranges to [q^e].

errors.says: The recurrence unrolls with a=s/W<m^lambda to O(d^{lambda'}).
errors.paper: The unrolling uses a<=m^sigma<m^lambda: internal costs give e^lambda, and leaves at e<d^beta give e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}. Hence lambda'>max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}; a<m^lambda alone does not give the leaf bound.

errors.says: Method: conjugate the elementary shear H_i<-H_i+D_j for each one of Pi by triangular controlled shifts.
errors.paper: The triangular factors E_1, E_2 conjugate the whole addition of Pi D. Each one of Pi is then realized as D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange (H_i,D_j), D_j<-H_i-D_j, which uses exactly one interchange.

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. Two fast tape procedures (T1) feed the synthetic transforms and convolution (T2), then resampling with retained permutations, the chirp and cancellation (T3), and finally parameters, the CRT map, the twist, exact recovery and cost (T4). It thins at the foundations of T1: gadget correctness, the label table with L=Ich and L<N/2, and the derivation of tau from the deficits are only asserted. The layer unrolling is loose, and the error chain and the seven cost terms are stated as conclusions without their derivations.
